svg.title: What does the average hide?
svg.desc: Every dot pairs B1 and B2 mean forecast losses on one historical session
svg.text: Every dot pairs B1 and B2 mean forecast losses on one historical session
Below the diagonal: B2 wins that session. Above it: B1 wins. Equal scales; no points removed.
419 dots per panel. Session averages conceal intraday dispersion; this is not a calibration test.
